company.name: Fabraicate
company.shortDescription: Fabraicate designs and manufactures custom wire harnesses with online quoting and harness design tools.
company.description: Fabraicate designs and manufactures custom wire harnesses using an online platform for quoting and design. The company operates the Loombotic service, which lets hardware teams upload drawings or use a web-based harness editor to configure assemblies. Its system parses connector types, wire gauges, and pin assignments and returns instant pricing without manual callbacks. Fabraicate then manufactures IPC/WHMA-A-620 compliant harnesses, performs 100 percent electrical continuity testing, and ships completed units. It supports quantities from single prototypes through higher-volume production runs across robotics, electric vehicles, medical devices, aerospace, and consumer hardware. The platform is intended for engineering and hardware teams that need predictable lead times and digital access to harness manufacturing.
